patterns.purpose: Build an argument with evidence and changes of pace.
sections: One pull quote or visual interlude
patterns.desktop: Eight-column reading area with a two-column margin for annotations.
patterns.mobile: Move annotations below their related passage; retain heading order.
patterns.conversion: A relevant next story or a well-contextualized inquiry.

patterns.purpose: Make an authored collection browsable and comparable.
patterns.desktop: One featured entry followed by a structured index, not equally loud covers.
patterns.mobile: Single-column entries; preserve search and filters.
patterns.conversion: Choose an entry or submit a useful contribution.

patterns.purpose: Balance a personal story with practical attendance tasks.
patterns.desktop: Invitation-sized opening followed by a timeline and plain logistics groups.
patterns.mobile: Vertical timeline; RSVP remains reachable from navigation.
patterns.conversion: Attend or respond without being forced through every story panel.
